title: Add PersonaMorph to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [PersonaMorph](https://personamorph-ai-production.up.railway.app) to image
- A professional AI Identity Studio allowing users to connect their Pollinations wallets and transform their photos into various artistic personas using the /v1/images/edits endpoint. Features: OAuth 2.

Fixes #15057

gist.headline: New faces in the garden
gist.blurb: PersonaMorph joined the image garden, bringing a studio for turning photos into artistic personas. Connect a Pollinations wallet, pick a direction, and let the pixels do their small identity crisis.
gist.summary: Added PersonaMorph to the app directory: an AI Identity Studio that connects Pollinations wallets and uses the /v1/images/edits endpoint to transform photos into artistic personas with OAuth 2.
gist.impact: Users can now discover PersonaMorph as a wallet-connected way to create artistic photo transformations through Pollinations image edits.
gist.visual_concept: Depict PersonaMorph as a cozy identity studio: a retro photo booth or artist's mirror showing several gentle pixel-art portrait personas. Polli, wearing a tiny painter's beret, helps arrange photo cards while a code-plant and flowers grow beside a lime-green glowing image-edit terminal.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art identity studio where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny painter's beret, happily pins several artistic pixel portrait cards around a retro mirror while a lime green (#ecf874) terminal runs an image-edit tool; code-plants, flowers, and soft pastel photo-backdrop curtains make the room feel warm and creative. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text reading "PERSONAMORPH".
